user.title: Connect to a SAJ inverter
user.description: Enter the local Modbus TCP endpoint, polling interval and model. Leave the model on Automatic unless the inverter is not recognised.

confirm_model.title: Confirm model
confirm_model.description: The device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised as {model}, so it could not be verified as that model. Its required registers answered, but readings may be wrong if it is a different model. Use {model} anyway?

error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address.
error.invalid_unit_id: Enter a whole-number unit ID from 1 to 247.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or read the inverter. Check the endpoint and try again.
error.unsupported_device: The device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised automatically. Choose its model manually.
error.invalid_device_data: The inverter returned invalid identity or telemetry data.
error.timeout: The inverter did not respond in time. Check the endpoint and try again.
error.read_rejected: The inverter rejected a required register read. Check that this is a supported SAJ device and model.
error.invalid_port: Enter a whole-number port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid port and unit ID.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole-number polling interval of at least 30 seconds.
error.model_mismatch: This device identifies as {detected_model}, not {selected_model}. Choose {detected_model} or Automatic.
error.unknown_model: The model {selection} is not a known model. Choose Automatic or one of the listed models.

abort.confirmation_not_pending: No validated change is awaiting confirmation.

init.title: Connection and polling
